thread:
nina: Heads-up: marketing ready with the release post copy and hero benchmark. Need final publish time, changelog permalink, docs link, and webinar schedule. Proposing Thu Apr 16, 10:00am PT.
carlos: 10:00am PT collides with our infra snapshot. Can we do 11:00am PT instead?
ellie: 11:00am PT okay for comms. Product rehearsal can be 11:30 if that helps.
dave: Eng has a minor Dedicated deploy 11:15-11:45 PT. Recommend announce at 12:00pm PT to avoid overlap.
nina: OK, 12:00pm PT works. We'll slot webinar at 13:00 PT (30m demo + 20m Q&A).
ellie: Webinar speakers confirmed: Ellie (PM), Dave (eng), Nina (marketing). Rehearsal 12:00 PT same day? Might be tight with announce.
dave: Rehearsal 11:00 PT for eng ok. I'll prepare a short slide with p50/p95 + cost delta.
nina: Benchmark headline we want: "Median token latency reduced ~18% for real app mixes" + link to appendix. Keep the blog lead simple.
dave: I'll drop the CSV and short JSON summary in benchmarks: https://files.redwood/benchmarks/0.9.3/summary.csv
carlos: Changelog flow: engineer publishes PR to changelog repo, QA approves, merge -> then marketing merges blog referencing the changelog permalink. Please don't merge blog earlier.
ops-sdr: Inbound routing: tag all release leads with `release-0.9.3`, set Intercom path to `events@redwood.com`, and create SFDC queue `MRKT_0_9_3`.
ellie: Docs PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/990  includes benchmark appendix and canary routing note. Need approvals by Wed EOD.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: 2026-04-16 11:15:00 PT -> 2026-04-16 11:45:00 PT. No production deploys between 10:30 PT and 12:15 PT.
nina: New plan: rehearsal 11:00 PT, canary/deploy 11:15-11:45, announce blog publish 12:00 PT, webinar 13:00 PT. Ellie will add FAQ snippet on Dedicated vs Hosted latency.
dave: Quick wording for marketing: "Adaptive batching + optimized kernels cut median token latency ~18% on mixed-concurrency workloads." Use as-is if short.
ops-sdr: I'll wire the Zap for SFDC and set auto-tagging. Also create a canned response for P1 inbound "See release notes and ping #eng-oncall".
carlos: Changelog PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/459  Please review.
nina: Action list: Dave upload benchmarks, Ellie finish FAQ bullets, Carlos watch changelog merge, Ops-SDR configure lead routing, Nina to merge blog once changelog+docs green.
